sourceEvidence.claim: Thinking text and signature deltas are accumulated separately; signature deltas do not emit visible reasoning text.
Assistant thinking with valid replay signature is serialized; reasoning in user/tool-result bodies is filtered without deleting ordinary text/results or durable history.
Replay metadata requires matching source provider and model. A target-model mismatch omits replay signature from the outbound copy.
Summary output collects text blocks only and uses compacted-summary wrapping.

articleImage.use: Intact image in a tightly fitting Mac frame with camera focus; not decomposed or repainted.

authoredUI: Authored mechanism animation using the shared PixelWorld palette. Paper represents thinking; orange lock represents signature; gold page represents summary. No new recording or model call.
semanticBoundaries: Archive and outbound request copy are separate. Removing a signature does not delete the durable stored history.
Discarded reasoning during compaction belongs to the summary-generation call; task summary text remains.
Task goal, progress and todo rows illustrate summary roles, not verbatim model output.
Cache pairing is a conceptual visualization of prefix reuse, not measured hit rate or guaranteed reuse.
Signature fragments and token symbols are schematic; no actual signature bytes or token counts are claimed.
Display uses deepseek-pro short model name at user request; the unchanged narration’s deepseek-v4-pro names the same source-model example, not the default selection.
